{"draft": "Veralto earnings rise in third quarter as company raises full-year outlook

Veralto reported third-quarter sales that climbed 7.5% to $1,509 million, with non-GAAP core sales growth of 5.1%.

Operating profit margin was 19.7%, while non-GAAP adjusted operating profit margin reached 25.6%. Net earnings were $253 million, or $1.03 per diluted common share, and non-GAAP adjusted net earnings were $290 million, or $1.18 per diluted common share.

The company generated operating cash flow of $323 million and non-GAAP free cash flow of $304 million during the quarter.

Year to date, the company deployed $1.1 billion on four strategic acquisitions and repurchased $550 million of shares, representing 2.4% of outstanding shares. Its Cost Optimization Program is now expected to deliver full-year 2026 savings of $10 million to $15 million.

For the fourth quarter, the company expects non-GAAP core sales growth of 5.5% to 6.5% year over year and an adjusted operating profit margin of approximately 24.5%.

The company raised its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings per share guidance to $4.49 to $4.52, representing growth of 15% to 16% over the prior year."}
